svg.title: MSCA-Dilated context and channel weights
svg.desc: Three independent 3 by 3 grouped convolution branches sample with dilation 1, 2 and 4. Their concatenated context is projected to full width and evaluated by the energy gate. In a separate branch, pooling and two pointwise convolutions reduce 1024 channels to 128 and restore 1024, yielding a single weight per channel. The two weights are multiplied first and then applied to the original F.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 5. Scientific source: Figure 5 label sheet, MSCA_Dilated.__init__ and forward, and revision 44 section 3.3. Sequential products informed by the author's MSCA-Dilated.png.. Paper figure references: local academic-diagram atlas, DrivoR Fig. 1 (continuous paths and inline notation), TabICL Fig. 2 (operator notation and residual wiring).
